ui:help.en: Root address of the Sub2API site; each protocol goes to its official path under it. A trailing /v1 or /v1beta is removed.
ui:help.zh: 填 Sub2API 站点的根地址，各协议按官方路径拼在它后面；末尾的 /v1 或 /v1beta 会被去掉。

ui:help.en: A key of the site. Which protocols it serves depends on its group on the site: narrow the account's protocols with the protocol binding as needed. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
ui:help.zh: 站点的 Key。上游 Key 能用哪些协议取决于它所在的分组，用协议绑定按需收窄。加密保存，保存后不再明文显示。
